segments.description: Offers revolutionary plant-based meat products replicating animal-based meat across beef, pork and poultry categories.
segments.evidence: We have one operating segment and one reportable segment, in the plant-based meat industry, offering a portfolio of revolutionary plant-based meat.

revenueModel.text: Revenue comes from sales of plant-based meat products to distributors, retailers and food-away-from-home customers at agreed prices.
revenueModel.evidence: Our revenues are generated through sales of our products to distributors or customers.
